searchText: Kind of wondering what APR will be post Shanghai and if that’ll vary based on central bank policy So, assume you have 1800 validators exiting per day, then that's 1800*34 ETH (on average) = 61200 ETH per day of full withdrawals. If you then filled all the rest of withdrawal capacity with partial withdrawals (~2ETH on average for the first scan, then much less), you'd get 7200 blocks x 16 withdrawals/block = 115200 withdrawals per day, of which 1800 were full withdrawals, so (115200-1800)x2=226800 ETH in partial withdrawals. So ~300k total for the first scan. This is also a conservative estimate because not all validators will have valid withdrawal credentials set. There we go thank you I'm also sure that's a very conservative figure, due to the reasons citeed (withdrawal credentials) + what's already liquid out there from LSDs, clear as crystal, appreciate it is the BLS change withdrawal operation limited to number of validators per slot ? 16
